name: Link Story of the Lost
source:
Trapped in an endless maze, two lost souls try in vain to the exit.
But there can be no end for them, forever locked from the answers they yearn for.
Yet they chatter on, bound together by LINKs.
This is part of their story, 
the story of their LINK.

[From [url=https://www.deviantart.com/centridus/art/Link-Story-of-the-Lost-252420769] Deviantart[/url]]
